name: Rolling Balls Sea Race 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Rolling Balls Sea Race is a casual driving physics-based racing game that propels you through stunning sea routes, where precision and speed are the keys to victory. Roll your way across vibrant platforms, mastering the art of ball control as you race solo or face off against a friend in thrilling 2-player mode.
